versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the " 彩票智能分析助手" (lottery-analyzer) skill for advanced analysis of SSQ and DLT lottery data.
- Includes complete, pre-validated historical SSQ data (3438 periods from 2003 to 2026) for immediate use, with no extra downloads needed.
- Provides statistical analysis, hot & cold number tracking, pattern recognition, and intelligent, multi-strategy number recommendations (single or combinational/复式).
- Features built-in data updating: both automated (via messages/scripts) and manual batch update options with validation.
- Offers user-friendly scripts and clear instructions for quick analysis, smart recommendations, and data management.
- Supports flexible workflows, custom data imports, and extension for advanced users.
